user.title: Setup NeoSmartBlinds
user.description: Enter the details for your NeoSmartBlinds device.

data_description.name: Friendly name shown in Home Assistant.
data_description.host: Controller IP address from the Neo Smart Blinds app or your router.
data_description.hub_id: Controller ID from the Neo Smart Blinds app (Your Controllers).
data_description.blind_code: Blind or room code from the blind advanced page in the app (ID1.ID2-CHANNEL).
data_description.close_time: Seconds for the blind to move from fully open to closed.
data_description.port: Controller port. HTTP is 8838, TCP is 8839.
data_description.rail: Rail to move: 1 top, 2 bottom, 3 both (for supported motors).
data_description.percent_support: 0 favorites only, 1 hub handles percent, 2 estimate using close_time.
data_description.motor_code: Motor code from the app (shown under the blind code).
data_description.start_position: Initial position used on HA startup when percent support is enabled.
data_description.tilt_support: Show tilt controls in the UI (micro up/down).
data_description.command_backoff: Minimum delay between commands to the hub.
data_description.retry_count: Number of retries after a failed request.
data_description.debug_logging: Enable extra debug logs for this entry.
